description: This file defines the Spanish (Bolivia) culture information for the DateJS library, including locale-specific date formats, month and day names, regex patterns for parsing dates, timezones, and prototype methods for date manipulation.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Resets the time components of a date to midnight.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the date object to the current date and time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares the date with another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two dates are equal.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day based on its name.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month based on its name.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a given year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a specified month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the timezone name for a given offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the offset value for a timezone name.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets multiple date components based on a configuration object.

methods.name: moveToFirstDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the first day of its month.

methods.name: moveToLastDayOfMonth
methods.description: Moves the date to the last day of its month.

methods.name: moveToNthOccurrence
methods.description: Moves the date to the n-th occurrence of a specified day of the week.

methods.name: moveToDayOfWeek
methods.description: Moves the date to a specific day of the week.

methods.name: getWeek
methods.description: Returns the week number for the date.

methods.name: setWeek
methods.description: Sets the week number of the date.
